profile_text.body:
Palo Alto Networks is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (Nasdaq: PANW, CIK 0001327567) that its website describes as a leader in cybersecurity protection and software for modern enterprises. The company positions its offerings around Zero Trust architecture, network security, cloud workload protection, hybrid workforce security, threat intelligence, and security consulting, with stated audiences including CISOs, network security engineers, cloud architects, and SOC managers.

The company tracks one AI product on this site, Palo Alto Networks Precision AI, described as covering network security, Zero Trust integration, autonomous threat response, and critical infrastructure. The company's site also references the Strata Network Security Platform, which it describes as built for Zero Trust and powered by AI for real-time threat monitoring and prevention, and an AI-driven SecOps platform. A product called Idira is introduced on the site as a next-generation identity security platform described as securing every identity for the AI enterprise.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings beyond the basic public company registration are present in the held data.
